## What is this

- [ ] Adding a new server listing
- [ ] Editing an existing listing
- [ ] Removing a listing
- [ ] Something else (site code, docs, etc.)

## For a new or edited listing

- [ ] I copied `.github/server-listing-template.yml` and filled in every required field
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally
- [ ] I only set `official: true` because I maintain the underlying product or service, not just the MCP server itself
- [ ] This server isn't already listed under a different name
